fusions.name: Full-Draw Harpoon
fusions.desc: Looses a harpoon at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach, and always lands as a critical hit. Its barbed line slows the target by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Quiver of Barbs
fusions.desc: Shoots a barbed arrow that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 50% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Paid-Out Line
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Nock After the Set
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next strike has 20% more critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
